c_compiler:
- gcc
c_compiler_version:
- '14'
c_stdlib:
- sysroot
c_stdlib_version:
- '2.17'
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
cxx_compiler:
- gxx
cxx_compiler_version:
- '14'
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma9
geotiff:
- '1.7'
gflags:
- '2.2'
glog:
- '0.7'
hdf5:
- 1.14.6
- '2'
libarrow:
- '21.0'
- '22.0'
- '23.0'
- '24.0'
libblas:
- 3.9.* *netlib
libcblas:
- 3.9.* *netlib
libcurl:
- '8'
libgdal_core:
- '3.13'
libpq:
- '18'
libxml2_devel:
- '2.14'
openssl:
- '3.5'
proj:
- '9.8'
target_platform:
- linux-64
tiledb:
- '2.30'
xerces_c:
- '3.3'

- - c_compiler_version
  - cxx_compiler_version

- '1'

- '1.5'
name: libpdal-core
raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "2.10.2"

recipe:
  name: libpdal-split
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/PDAL/PDAL/releases/download/${{ version }}/PDAL-${{ version }}-src.tar.bz2
  sha256: 882b97aa3ae5db682c3b2dc8edef4e29bcc7ecea51c70592e71bc1f34112ad00

build:
  number: 1

outputs:
  - package:
      name: libpdal-core
    build:
      script:
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/build.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\build.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - pkg-config
      host:
        - libgdal-core
        - geotiff
        - libcurl
        - zstd
        - openssl
        - zlib
        - libxml2-devel
        - proj
      run:
        # Help the solver pick an icu-compatible libxml2; libgdal-core depends
        # on xerces-c, which pulls in icu on unix.
        - if: unix
          then: icu *
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - echo "Testing for header"
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/include/pdal/pdal.hpp
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_INC%\pdal\pdal.hpp exit 1
            - echo "Testing for library"
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdalcpp${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\pdalcpp.dll exit 1
            - echo "Testing for CLI"
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/bin/pdal
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\pdal.exe exit 1
            - pdal --version
            - pdal --drivers --debug

  - package:
      name: libpdal
    requirements:
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-pgpointcloud', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-arrow', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-nitf', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - if: not win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-pgpointcloud', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-arrow', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-nitf', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
        - if: not win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x.x') }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-pgpointcloud', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-arrow', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-nitf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - if: not win
          then: ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - echo "tested in other outputs"

  - package:
      name: libpdal-trajectory
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: trajectory
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-core
        - ceres-solver
        - glog
        - gflags
        - if: unix
          then: libblas
        - if: unix
          then: libcblas
        - if: win
          then: mkl-devel
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-trajectory', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - libblas
          - libcblas
          - if: win
            then: mkl-devel
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_filter_trajectory${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_filter_trajectory.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: PDAL trajectory filter
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-hdf
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: hdf
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - libgdal-hdf5
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-hdf5
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-hdf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_hdf${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_hdf.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-draco
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: draco
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - draco
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('draco', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-draco', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_draco${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_draco.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_draco${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_draco.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-e57
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: e57
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - xerces-c
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-e57', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_e57${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_e57.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_e57${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_e57.dll exit 1

  - package:
      name: libpdal-icebridge
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: icebridge
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-hdf5
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-icebridge', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_icebridge${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_icebridge.dll exit 1

  - package:
      name: libpdal-tiledb
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: tiledb
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - tiledb
        - if: unix
          then: icu *
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-tiledb
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-tiledb', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - if: unix
            then: icu
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_tiledb${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_tiledb.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_tiledb${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_tiledb.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-pgpointcloud
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: pgpointcloud
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - libpq
        - libxml2-devel
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-pg
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-pgpointcloud', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_pgpointcloud${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_pgpointcloud.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-arrow
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: arrow
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - libarrow
        - libarrow-dataset
        - libparquet
        - if: unix
          then: icu *
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
        - libgdal-arrow-parquet
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-arrow', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - if: unix
            then: icu
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_writer_arrow${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_writer_arrow.dll exit 1
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_arrow${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_arrow.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-nitf
    build:
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: nitf
        content:
          - if: unix
            then: bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
            else: call %RECIPE_DIR%\install_pdal_plugin.bat
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - nitro
        - libcurl
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('nitro', exact=True) }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-nitf', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - libcurl
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - if: unix
              then: test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_reader_nitf${SHLIB_EXT}
              else: if not exist %LIBRARY_BIN%\libpdal_plugin_reader_nitf.dll exit 1
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

  - package:
      name: libpdal-cpd
    build:
      skip: win
      script:
        env:
          PDAL_PLUGIN_NAME: cpd
        content:
          - bash ${RECIPE_DIR}/install_pdal_plugin.sh
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - eigen
      host:
        - cpd
        - fgt
        - icu *
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run:
        - ${{ pin_compatible('cpd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_compatible('fgt', upper_bound='x.x') }}
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-core', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('libpdal-cpd', upper_bound='x.x') }}
      run_constraints:
        - pdal ${{ version }}.*
      ignore_run_exports:
        from_package:
          - icu
    tests:
      - script:
          content:
            - test -f ${PREFIX}/lib/libpdal_plugin_filter_cpd${SHLIB_EXT}
    about:
      summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
      license: BSD-3-Clause
      license_file: LICENSE.txt

about:
  homepage: https://www.pdal.io
  license: BSD-3-Clause
  license_file: LICENSE.txt
  summary: Point Data Abstraction Library (PDAL)
  description: Point cloud data processing.
  documentation: https://pdal.io
  repository: https://github.com/pdal/pdal

extra:
  feedstock-name: libpdal
  recipe-maintainers:
    - chambbj
    - hobu
